governanceNotes: D1 batch 27 (2026-09-23): deferred on duplicate-scope under the diabetes-mellitus-typed-identities and atopic-march precedents - the published atopic-dermatitis evidence base (Bawany 2021 sleep review, Silverberg 2021 US population survey, Fasseeh 2021 burden systematic review, Mann 2020 ISI flare cohort, Cranendonk 2018 cellulitis pathophysiology, Hartman-Adams 2014 impetigo, Moses 2003 pruritus scratch-complications review, all batch-20 sources on the dermatitis identity) is already carried by the dermatitis -> insomnia/cellulitis/impetigo/depressive-disorder/anxiety-disorder edges, and atopic-dermatitis-eczema -> asthma already exists (atopic-march precedent), so authoring eczema -> any of those targets would create parallel pathways restating the same disease process under a synonym identity.

The identity is a common clinical synonym for atopic dermatitis rather than a distinct disease process; consolidation or inheritance of the dermatitis edges is a qualified-human governance decision and is not made here. Reopening condition: a condition-specific pathway with its own published evidence base distinct from the atopic-dermatitis literature (for example, an eczema-specific cohort outcome not explained by the AD evidence) would justify re-screening this identity.
